composition_space.composition_order: increasing split_count, then lexicographic split-position tuple
composition_space.ordered_composition_encoding: split-position tuple S subset {1,...,k-1}; block lengths are consecutive differences of (0,S,k)
composition_space.reverse_composition: split set S maps to sorted(k-r for r in S)

description_units.equivariant_stump_formula: program_root_overhead + k_selector + score_opcode + integer_parameter_count + plus_leaf + zero_leaf + mirror_operator
description_units.invariant_stump_formula: program_root_overhead + k_selector + predicate_opcode + integer_parameter_count + true_leaf + false_leaf

deterministic_candidate_order.compositions: increasing split_count then lexicographic split tuple

G1_CONSTANT.semantics: one ordered composition for all packets of one fixed k

G1_INVARIANT_BOOLEAN_STUMP.leaf_space: reversal-symmetric ordered compositions only for both leaves

predicate_families.name: TURN_SIGN_CHANGE_COUNT_GE
predicate_families.value: number of adjacent turn-sign changes >= t

predicate_families.name: MAX_SAME_SIGN_TURN_RUN_GE
predicate_families.value: maximum same-sign run length in turn_word >= t

G1_INVARIANT_BOOLEAN_STUMP.semantics: IF invariant predicate P(packet) THEN pi_true ELSE pi_false

G1_REFLECTION_EQUIVARIANT_TERNARY_STUMP.leaf_space: pi_plus any ordered composition; pi_zero reversal-symmetric ordered composition; negative leaf is implicit mirror
G1_REFLECTION_EQUIVARIANT_TERNARY_STUMP.semantics: compute exact antisymmetric score A; if A>0 use pi_plus; if A<0 use reverse(pi_plus); if A=0 use reversal-symmetric pi_zero

g1_search_procedure.candidate_semantics: packet-level; aggregation by identical teacher-free direction words is an implementation acceleration only and is not a grammar predicate
g1_search_procedure.enumeration: exhaust every candidate in the frozen G1 program space for each k
g1_search_procedure.stopping_rule: all frozen candidates evaluated for every k

g2_high_capacity_benchmark.canonical_frame_output: class stores an ordered composition in canonical traversal frame; rotations preserve split positions; reflected occurrences map split r back to k-r using the deterministic first canonicalizing D6 action
g2_high_capacity_benchmark.key: frozen corrected spatial-D6 canonical packet class only
g2_high_capacity_benchmark.optimizer: deterministic discrete coordinate descent over classes and all ordered compositions
g2_high_capacity_benchmark.stopping_rule: first full class sweep with no objective improvement, else 12 sweeps

g3_policy.default_for_stage_b1: NOT_EXECUTED unless a separate post-G2 compression is scientifically necessary; no teacher-role information may be used

local_input_semantics.all_predicate_evaluation: exact integer/rational arithmetic from frozen direction word / x6,y6 geometry
allowed: exact comparisons among local chord quantities
exact dot/determinant relations among local chord vectors

metrics.P_hat: (1/k) * sum over every cyclic packet start of selected composition chord sum
metrics.orientation_stability_metric: RMS across 4 orientation mean relative biases
metrics.phase_stability_metric: RMS across 12 phase mean relative biases

numerical_boundary.chord_length: sqrt(exact rational q) evaluated numerically only after local exact q is fixed
numerical_boundary.finalist_recheck: 100 decimal digits using mpmath for every reported winner and any candidate within 1e-10 relative objective distance of a preceding winner component
numerical_boundary.global_optimum_label: GLOBAL_OPTIMUM_NOT_CLAIMED despite exhaustive discrete enumeration because objective comparison contains irrational numerical readouts
numerical_boundary.unresolved_near_tie_policy: if high-precision ordering remains unresolved at 1e-70, preserve tie and use deterministic candidate order; do not claim exact algebraic ordering

selection_and_pareto.pareto_dominance: weakly no worse in every dimension and strictly better in at least one
